thread:
Priya: quick heads-up — planning sprint lanes for model onboarding. want to surface the customer-driven asks and lock acceptance gates. who can join a short sync?
Alex: I can join. TL;DR: LargeCorp + Shoply asked for pin TTL guarantees, clear latency SLO, and a documented fallback plan.
Marco: adding rough bench targets we should aim for: p95 latency <= 300ms on dedicated pools, accuracy delta <= 1.5% vs baseline evals.
Lina: canary cadence proposal: 1% traffic for 48h, then 10% for 24h, rollback if any meaningful regressions.
Priya: thinking about onboarding buckets: 
- Fast lane: auto-accept if infra smoke + basic bench pass (no SLA)
- Negotiated lane: requires sales contract + extended canary + pinned TTL option
- Exception lane: manual review for sensitive customers
Thoughts?
Alex: worried about auto-accept for customers with strict quality needs. propose we require a `customer.strict_output=true` opt-in to exclude them from Fast lane.
Marco: ops asks: default pin TTL = 90 days (configurable per-tenant). need soft-rollback tooling and embeddings schema compatibility shim for customers mid-migration.
Priya: benchmark snippet for product doc:
```json
{"p95_latency_ms":300, "accuracy_delta_pct":1.5, "determinism_score":0.9}
```
Lina: how do we compute accuracy_delta_pct? we need a canonical eval set per cohort + standard metric definitions. who owns that?
Alex: product + research should own eval sets. I'll coordinate w/ @matt_r to stitch existing suites and avoid duplication.
Marco: also add a cost gate for model variants (especially quantized): cost_per_token delta <= 20% vs baseline, otherwise require manual sign-off.
Priya: agree. also add rollback gate: any customer-observed error increase >5% triggers immediate rollback and incident page.
Lina: can we add a 6-month gracepath for pinned customers (monthly checkpoints with opt-in migration helpers)? ops can enforce quotas during grace period.
Alex: :thumbsup: sounds good. Communications: we should prepare a templated notice for pinned customers: "model will be deprecated on X unless you choose to pin or migrate". sales_ops should preview.
Priya: action items: Alex -> draft opt-in flag change + comm template; Marco -> update canary runbook and add cost gate; Lina -> own eval cohort mapping; Priya -> assemble acceptance checklist + sprint ticket by EOD Friday.
Marco: I'll also prototype a small migration helper script to convert prompt templates and embedding fields (v1). will post in repo.
Priya: cool. sync Friday 10am to review checklist and any open exceptions. if no blockers i'll mark sprint ticket and PRD ready.
canary-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-runbook v2 will be applied to sandbox at 2026-04-02T18:00:00Z
Alex: noted. tagging @sales_ops to prep customer comms for LargeCorp and Shoply.
Priya: thanks — bringing this into the sprint board now.
Lina: one last ask — include a tiny acceptance test for output-format stability (schema + examples) so SDKs don't break.
Marco: good call. i'll add schema checks to the canary job.
Priya: perfect, see you all Friday. :v:
